panels.title: Needs attention (24h)
panels.description: Runs that did not pass (failed, invalid, error, terminated, or stopped as stuck, budget, refusal, oracle-unavailable, verdict-boundary), plus viewers that saw no run_end. Their herdr pane stays open.

panels.title: Running now
panels.description: Runs with a run_start and no run_end in the last 3h (a run killed without cleanup counts until it leaves the window).

targets.expr: count(sum by (run_id) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="run_start" [3h])) unless on (run_id) sum by (run_id) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="run_end" [3h])))

panels.title: Viewer panes open (24h)
panels.description: herdr viewer panes opened (view_opened) that pi-view has not closed (view_closed, on a pass). Panes of runs needing attention stay open until closed by hand, which Loki does not see.

targets.expr: count(sum by (run_id) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="view_opened" [24h])) unless on (run_id) sum by (run_id) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="view_closed" [24h])))

panels.title: Runs needing attention (time range)
panels.description: attention events: why the run stopped, who asked and through what. Look one up with pi-view <run id>.

targets.expr: sum by (run_id, reason, status, repo, requested_by, via, issue) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="attention" [$__range]))

sum by (run_id, repo, host, provenance_requested_by, provenance_via, provenance_issue) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="run_start" [3h])) unless on (run_id) sum by (run_id) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="run_end" [3h]))

panels.title: Process passed (24h)
panels.description: Worker process status only. Independent checks and review are separate evidence; a pass does not prove a correct patch.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="pi-agent"} | json | event="run_end" | unwrap elapsed_s [24h]) by (job)
sum by (physical_model) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="assistant" | label_format physical_model=`{{ or .served_model .model "unknown" }}` [$__interval]))

sum by (physical_model) (sum_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="assistant" | label_format physical_model=`{{ or .served_model .model "unknown" }}` | unwrap tokens_in | __error__="" [$__interval]))

sum by (physical_model) (sum_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="assistant" | label_format physical_model=`{{ or .served_model .model "unknown" }}` | unwrap tokens_out | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: SDLC loop: red evaluations by stage
SDLC loop: autofix vs Pi packets, stuck, regressions, budget stops
pi-ticket runs today (UTC) vs cap 5
panels.description: pi-offload run_start events requested via pi-ticket since 00:00 UTC: the same count pi-ticket's daily cap (5, all hosts) checks before dispatch.

panels.title: Accepted to review
panels.description: pi-ticket issue outcomes in the time range that passed G0-G3 cleanly and opened a draft PR (agent:pi-review). A red-then-green retry (outcome review-flaky) also opens a PR but is not counted here (ADR-028 §6).

panels.title: Blocked
panels.description: pi-ticket issue outcomes in the time range that went to agent:pi-blocked (any gate, including quota).

panels.title: Pass rate
panels.description: Accepted to review / all pi-ticket issue outcomes in the time range; review-flaky counts as not passed.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="pi-agent", source="pi-ticket"} | json | event="issue_outcome" | outcome="review" [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({job="pi-agent", source="pi-ticket"} | json | event="issue_outcome" [$__range]))

panels.title: Flagged retries, 30d (red, then green)
panels.description: Last 30 days: runs whose repo sdlc gate was red, then green on the one retry (ADR-028 §6). Each is a flaky test in the repo or a change the reviewer must check; look at every one. The event push is best effort: a lost push shows as outcome_push false in the run host's runs.jsonl, and the PR still carries the flag.

panels.title: Pi tokens per accepted diff
panels.description: Pi tokens of the runs accepted to review / their count, in the time range. Tokens of earlier blocked attempts at the same issue are not included.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({job="pi-agent", source="pi-ticket"} | json | event="issue_outcome" | outcome="review" | unwrap pi_tokens [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({job="pi-agent", source="pi-ticket"} | json | event="issue_outcome" | outcome="review" [$__range]))

panels.title: pi-ticket runs per day (last 7 days, UTC, cap 5)
panels.description: pi-offload run_start events requested via pi-ticket, one bar per UTC day, today so far included (up to an hour behind; the stat above is live). Counted per hour and summed per day (a [1d] range query would put each day's count on the next day, homelab-gitops#110). The red line is the daily cap.

panels.title: Issue outcomes per day by gate (last 7 days, UTC)
panels.description: One bar per UTC day, today so far included (up to an hour behind). review = passed G0-G3 cleanly; review-flaky = passed after one flagged retry; blocked shows the gate it stopped at (lint, prepare, quota, g2 Pi, g3 verify, push, pr, internal). Pass rate by gate over time.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome, gate) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent", source="pi-ticket"} | json | event="issue_outcome" [1h]))

panels.title: Flagged retries (last 30 days)
panels.description: Every red-then-green repo gate: the PR carries the first failure and the reviewer must acknowledge it. Repeated stages or repos point at a flaky test to fix.

targets.expr: sum by (issue, run_id, sdlc_stage, pr) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent", source="pi-ticket"} | json | event="issue_outcome" | flaky="true" [$__range]))

panels.title: Blocked issues by gate and reason (time range)
panels.description: The issue comment holds the full evidence; the reason here is masked and cut to 200 characters (e.g. test-set-shrank, red-not-passing, sdlc red twice, quota).

targets.expr: sum by (gate, reason, issue, run_id) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent", source="pi-ticket"} | json | event="issue_outcome" | outcome="blocked" [$__range]))

panels.title: Issue runs: rounds, wall time, tokens, served model (time range)
panels.description: One row per pi-ticket outcome. Look a run up with pi-view <run id>.

targets.expr: sum by (issue, outcome, gate, run_id, rounds, elapsed_s, pi_tokens, served_model, sdlc_result) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent", source="pi-ticket"} | json | event="issue_outcome" [$__range]))

panels.title: Pi tokens per day by served model (pi-ticket runs, last 7 days, UTC)
panels.description: pi_tokens of each issue outcome, one bar per UTC day, today so far included (up to an hour behind).

targets.expr: sum by (served_model) (sum_over_time({job="pi-agent", source="pi-ticket"} | json | event="issue_outcome" | unwrap pi_tokens [1h]))

panels.title: pi-offload runs and first-pass rate by class and model (time range)
panels.description: One platform record (kind=offload) per pi-offload run, on a host or a guest. First pass: the check went green on the first round.

targets.expr: sum by (class, model) (count_over_time({job="platform", kind="offload"} | logfmt | first_pass="1" [$__range])) / sum by (class, model) (count_over_time({job="platform", kind="offload"} | logfmt [$__range])) or 0 * sum by (class, model) (count_over_time({job="platform", kind="offload"} | logfmt [$__range]))

panels.title: Tool calls and errors by tool (time range)
panels.description: Counts include command exits and unsuccessful edits; error count alone does not establish model correctness. Zero errors is shown only for tools with observed calls.

targets.expr: sum by (tool) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="tool" | is_error="true" [$__range])) or 0 * sum by (tool) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="tool" [$__range]))

panels.title: Tool error ratio by tool (time range)

targets.expr: (sum by (tool) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="tool" | is_error="true" [$__range])) or 0 * sum by (tool) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="tool" [$__range]))) / sum by (tool) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="tool" [$__range]))

panels.title: Starts older than 3h without observed end (24h)
panels.description: Candidate orphan runs: starts observed 3–24 hours ago with no end in 24 hours. A genuinely long run, lost logs, or collector outage can also appear. This is not proof that the process is running.

targets.expr: (sum by (run_id, repo, host) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="run_start" [24h])) unless on (run_id) sum by (run_id) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="run_start" [3h]))) unless on (run_id) sum by (run_id) (count_over_time({job="pi-agent"} | json | event="run_end" [24h]))

panels.title: Responses missing served model (time range)
panels.description: Assistant events without served_model. Model charts fall back to the requested alias, then unknown; these events cannot prove physical-model attribution.

panels.title: Local-model lane: tasks and local share by model (time range)
panels.description: One platform record (kind=local-lane) per task scripts/local-lane.py ran through its gate (#807). Local share: tasks the gate passed, on the first attempt or the one retry, over all tasks; one that failed went to a hosted agent (rescued). Failed: the first gate item that failed; a run skipped with no local model up (failed=no-local-model) counts there and in neither the tasks nor the share. Keep a model on the lane while its share holds 50 percent after 20 tasks.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (count_over_time({job="platform", kind="local-lane"} | logfmt | result="passed" [$__range])) / sum by (model) (count_over_time({job="platform", kind="local-lane"} | logfmt | result!="skipped" [$__range])) or 0 * sum by (model) (count_over_time({job="platform", kind="local-lane"} | logfmt | result!="skipped" [$__range]))
sum by (model, failed) (count_over_time({job="platform", kind="local-lane"} | logfmt | result!="passed" [$__range]))
